login.title: Admin sign-in
login.intro: Sign in to change watch photos, prices and availability. Buyers never see these tools.
login.remember: Keep me signed in on this device
login.locked: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {s} seconds.
login.off: Admin sign-in is switched off. Set a passcode in config.js to turn it on.
login.notset: Admin sign-in is not set up yet. Add ADMIN_PASSCODE in your Vercel settings and redeploy.
login.error: Couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

strip.desk: Lagos private desk · Nigeria · Ghana · Kenya · South Africa

brands.title: Names that shape the vault
brands.text: From independent icons to legendary maisons, we source and trade pieces with a story.
brands.listLabel: Watch houses in the Braid network

hero.title: Inspect live availability, verify listing timestamps, and pay our merchant directly — by transfer, card, mobile money or crypto.

admin.text: You are signed in. Tap a status pill to change availability, or open a watch to edit it and change its photo.
admin.warn: Merchant chat is not connected yet. Add WHATSAPP_NUMBER and TELEGRAM_USERNAME in your Vercel settings.
admin.dbLive: Live database connected. Everything you save shows for all buyers right away.
admin.dbDevice: Preview mode: the live database is not connected, so changes are saved on this device only.
admin.dbMissing: The site is running but the database is not connected. In Vercel, open Storage, create an Upstash Redis database, connect it to this project and redeploy.
admin.genAllNone: Every watch already has a photo
admin.linksLabel: Paste the photo links you copied from the preview
admin.linksCopied: Photo links copied. Open your live site, sign in as admin, and tap Paste photo links.
admin.linksNone: There are no photos to copy yet. Generate or upload some first.
admin.linksBad: That doesn’t look like copied photo links. Copy them again from the preview.
admin.linksNoMatch: None of these photos match a watch on this site.

vault.loadError: The watches didn’t load. Check your connection and reload the page.
vault.emptyText: New pieces are listed here as soon as they arrive. You can also message us to ask what is coming.

boot.title: The vault didn’t open.
boot.text: Something didn’t load. Reload the page to try again. If it keeps happening, the note below names the file that is missing from your site. Upload it and redeploy.

empty.title: No pieces match your filters.
empty.text: Try another collection, clear the search, or switch off “Available only”.

partner.title: Own a watch store? Sell your watches through Braid.
partner.text: Tell our merchant what you stock. Approved pieces are shown to buyers in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya and South Africa.
partner.intro: Share a few details about your store. We send them to our merchant, who replies on WhatsApp or Telegram, usually within a day.
partner.messagePh: e.g. I want to list 12 Omegas and a few Seikos.
partner.doneText: Send this to our merchant. Add photos of your best pieces in the chat to speed things up.

footer.address: Victoria Island, Lagos · Delivering to Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya & South Africa

credit.visit: Visit Braidmesh.com (opens in a new tab)

avail.help: Choose whether buyers can order this watch right now.
avail.holdSub: A buyer is talking to us

kind.label: Watch type
kind.help: Normal is a current everyday watch, Classic is a timeless older design, Vintage is 30 years or older. It is suggested from the year, and you can change it.

extra.listedHelp: Buyers see this on the card. Leave it as it is for a fresh arrival.

look.title: Watch drawing
look.help: This drawing shows on the card until you add a photo. Pick a starting style, then adjust the shape and colours.

tools.title: Admin · edit this watch
tools.error: Couldn’t save the photo. Try a smaller picture, or check your connection and sign-in.
tools.noImage: This watch has no photo yet.
tools.linkBad: That link isn’t a picture. Right-click the photo, choose “Copy image address”, and paste that.
tools.hint: Changes save automatically. Buyers see them within a minute.

editor.notesPh: Tell buyers what makes this piece special.
editor.featured: Show as a wide featured card
editor.photoNone: No photo yet. A drawing is shown until you add one.
editor.photoReady: Photo added. It goes live when you tap Save watch.
editor.photoError: Couldn’t upload that photo. Try a smaller picture, or check your connection and sign-in.
editor.errYear: Please enter a year between 1800 and 2100.
editor.errPrice: Please enter the price in Naira, numbers only.

handoff.title: Buy this watch · pay the merchant directly
handoff.intro: Pick how you want to pay. Nothing is charged on this site: your order goes straight to our merchant, who confirms it and sends secure payment details in chat.

form.name: Your name or handle
form.notePh: e.g. Please send a wrist-roll video
form.contactHelp: So the merchant can reply to you, even if your chat app doesn’t open.

pay.title: How would you like to pay?
pay.safe: Nothing is charged here. The final amount is confirmed in chat. Only pay to account details the merchant sends you in that chat.

hint.escrow: Funds are held safely until you approve the watch.
hint.bank: Account details are sent in the chat.
hint.card: Visa or Mastercard through a secure link.
hint.crypto: Wallet address is sent in the chat.
hint.cash: Pay in person after you inspect it in Lagos.
hint.trade: Use your own watch as part of the payment.

mobile.KE: Paybill or Till number sent in chat.
mobile.GH: Mobile money number sent in chat.

delivery.video: Live video viewing first, then delivery

result.title: Request ready
result.hint: The merchant receives exactly this message and replies with secure payment details. If your chat app didn’t open, use a button below.
result.edit: ← Edit details or send another inquiry

order.s1t: Your request reaches the merchant desk.
order.s2t: Availability and final amount, usually within 30 minutes.

toast.saveFailed: Couldn’t save your change. Please try again.
toast.savedLive: Saved. Buyers can see this now.
toast.savedDevice: Saved on this device only, because the live database is not connected.
toast.sessionEnded: Your admin session ended. Please sign in again.
toast.loadFailed: Couldn’t reach the vault. Please check your connection and refresh.
toast.popup: Your browser blocked the chat window. Use the buttons below the message.
toast.tgCopied: Message copied. Paste it into the Telegram chat.
toast.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
toast.sellUnavailable: Sell / Trade is unavailable on this deployment. Please redeploy the latest files.

dossier.heading: BRAID WATCHES // ORDER REQUEST
dossier.defaultNote: Please confirm availability and the final amount, then send secure payment details.

sell.title: Sell or trade your watch
sell.intro: We buy vintage Rolex, Omega, Cartier, Tudor, Seiko and neo-vintage pieces outright, or take trades toward any vault watch. Add photos and we’ll reply with a cash or trade offer.
sell.photosMax: You can add up to {max} photos.
sell.tooBig: That photo is over 15 MB. Please choose a smaller one.

done.title: Valuation request ready
done.text: Send this to our acquisition desk. Offers usually come back within 30 minutes.
done.photos: {n} photo link(s) included in the message.
done.nophotos: No photos attached. Add some in the chat to speed up your offer.
done.nolinks: Photos couldn’t be uploaded. Please attach them in the chat.

inbox.title: Orders & messages
inbox.error: Couldn’t load the messages. Check your connection, then tap Refresh.
inbox.needDb: Messages are kept on your live site. Open your Vercel site, sign in as admin, and tap Messages there.
inbox.empty: No messages yet. New orders, valuation requests and store messages appear here the moment a buyer sends them.
inbox.emptyNew: Nothing new. Switch on “Show handled” to see finished ones.
inbox.newToast: New message at the merchant desk.
inbox.noContact: No contact left. Look for this one in your chat app.
inbox.actionFailed: Couldn’t update that message. Please try again.
inbox.sending: Saving a copy for the merchant…
inbox.sent: A copy is saved on the merchant’s desk, so your request can’t get lost.
inbox.sendFailed: We couldn’t save a copy for the merchant. Please send the message with a button below.
